plugins.name: codex-util
plugins.description: Use Codex AI features inside Claude Code via the ChatGPT subscription path (no Platform API key, no Node CLI fork per call)

plugins.name: nanobanana-mcp
plugins.description: Google Gemini image generation MCP server (Nano Banana) — flash and pro modes

plugins.name: autobot
plugins.description: App idea to TestFlight in one command. Enterprise-grade iOS 26+ app builder with parallel agent orchestration and self-improving build process.

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Professional UI/UX design intelligence for AI coding assistants. Includes searchable databases of styles, colors, typography, charts, and UX guidelines for React, Next.js, Astro, Vue, Nuxt.js, Nuxt UI, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, and Jetpack Compose.

plugins.name: axiom
plugins.description: Battle-tested Claude Code agents, skills, and references for modern xOS (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS) development

plugins.name: app-store-screenshots
plugins.description: End-to-end App Store and Google Play screenshot generator — scaffolds a Next.js project that renders advertisement-style screenshots for iPhone, iPad, Android phone/tablet, and Feature Graphic, then exports PNGs at all required Apple and Google resolutions.

plugins.name: cc-plugin-codex
plugins.description: An open-source plugin that runs inside Codex and lets you use Claude Code and Claude models for review, rescue, and tracked background workflows.

plugins.name: medium-to-tistory
plugins.description: Download a Medium article for topic inspiration, write a substantially original Korean post with a fresh hero image generated via codex-util:imagegen, and publish privately to Tistory in HTML mode. Glue between medium-cli and tistory-cli with IP-safe guardrails (no translation, no source images).

plugins.name: balsamiq-mockups-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server that lets Claude create and edit Balsamiq Wireframes (.bmpr) files programmatically — describe a screen in chat, get a real .bmpr you can open in Balsamiq.

plugins.name: design-prototype
plugins.description: Build working clickable product prototypes for co-design. Two-tab pattern: product.html (real interactions — hover, click, type, drag) + design.html (ClaudeDesign panel for proposals and roadmap). Conversation happens in the Claude terminal; the prototype reloads as you talk. NOT a static mockup, NOT A/B choice cards.

plugins.name: mcp-appstore
plugins.description: MCP server that scrapes Google Play and Apple App Store for ASO research — search apps, fetch details/reviews/keywords/similar apps without any auth. Wraps appreply-co/mcp-appstore with a one-shot setup that clones + installs on first launch.

plugins.name: app-store-connect-cli-skills
plugins.description: Agent Skills for the asc CLI (App Store Connect API) — automate TestFlight, builds, submissions, metadata sync, screenshots, signing, IAP/subscriptions, crash triage, and release flow for your own apps. Requires the asc binary (brew install asc).

plugins.name: qa-tc
plugins.description: Generate grounded, multi-platform QA test cases from Confluence/Figma/docs/URLs combined with code and on-device grounding. The spec is the source of truth — every test case must cite a SPEC quote (no hallucinated cases); code and mobile-mcp captures are the baseline, so cases come out labeled per platform as NEW / REGRESSION / MISMATCH / INFERRED. Pure Claude Code skill (in-session LLM + MCP, no daemon, zero runtime deps) that outputs a self-contained Rich HTML dashboard + CSV, with cross-group dedupe and a regression-collection model with [OBSOLETE] sweep.

plugins.name: humanize-korean
plugins.description: AI가 쓴 한글 텍스트를 사람이 쓴 글처럼 윤문 — Fast(monolith) + strict 5인 파이프라인. 10대 카테고리 40+ AI 티 패턴 탐지·재작성.
